📋 TEST SCENARIO
============== INTRODUCTION ================
============== INTRODUCTION ================ Test Scenario: Verify whether a flight-level alert can be created against a flight in Flights List View. Steps: 1. Authenticate / Login to application (managed via @pytest.mark.login). 2. Navigate to Flights List View. 3. Ensure Ongoing Section is active (do not navigate to other sections). 4. Select an eligible flight card with an available action menu. 5. Record the initial alert count from the flight card. 6. Click the Three-Dots menu ('more_vert') on the flight card. 7. Select 'Add Alert/Task' from the menu. 8. In the Add Alert/Task popup: - Enter Task Name as 'Test Alert' (based on category 'Alert'). - Select Alert Category as 'Alert' from the PrimeNG dropdown. - Select Alert Type toggle as 'Departure'. - Click 'Save' button to create the alert. 9. Refresh the Ongoing page using the Refresh icon ('Refresh Flight' / 'pi-sync') on the List View: - After refreshing, the system loading spinner will be displayed. - Wait for the loading spinner to complete. - Verify that the alert count has updated / increased for the flight. 10. Click on the Alert count column of the same flight to open the right-side Alert Details popup. 11. Verify whether the created alert ('Test Alert') is displayed in the right popup: - If displayed -> Test PASSED. - If not displayed -> Test FAILED. 12. Close the right-side Alert Details popup.
